text: Caller claims to be from Customs, Courier company, or FedEx, saying a parcel registered under the victim's name/Aadhaar contains illegal drugs, fake passports, or contraband. Used as the opening hook to create fear before transferring the call to a fake 'police officer'.
example_phrases: a parcel under your name containing illegal substances has been intercepted
your Aadhaar number is linked to a package containing drugs
this courier has your ID proof and banned items inside

text: Caller or video-caller claims to be a CBI, Enforcement Directorate, Customs, or local police officer, often wearing a uniform or sitting in front of a fake official backdrop, and shows a fabricated ID card or warrant on screen to appear legitimate.
example_phrases: this is officer speaking from CBI headquarters
I am showing you my official ID, this is a government investigation
we have issued a digital warrant against your name

text: Victim is told they cannot disconnect the call, leave the house, or inform any family member or lawyer, and that doing so will result in immediate physical arrest. This is the defining psychological tactic of the 'digital arrest' scam and rarely appears in legitimate law enforcement procedure.
example_phrases: do not disconnect the call or you will be arrested immediately
this is a confidential investigation, you cannot tell anyone
stay on video until the investigation is complete
if you leave this call your case will be escalated to non-bailable offence

text: Victim is instructed to transfer money to a bank account described as an 'RBI verification account', 'income tax clearance account', or similar, with a promise that funds will be refunded once innocence is proven. This is the monetization step of the scam.
example_phrases: transfer the amount to this RBI verification account, it will be refunded within 24 hours
to prove your innocence you must pay a security deposit
this amount will be returned once the investigation clears your name

text: Scammer imposes an artificial short deadline (minutes to a few hours) for payment or 'verification', preventing the victim from pausing to think, consult family, or verify independently.
example_phrases: you have only 30 minutes to comply or a lookout notice will be issued
the payment must be completed before the officer returns from lunch
this window closes in 15 minutes

text: Calls appear to originate from a number formatted to resemble an official government or police helpline, or from an international number disguised with a local prefix. Legitimate government agencies do not initiate arrest procedures via phone call.
example_phrases: caller ID displayed as police helpline
number prefix resembles Delhi Police control room
call originated from spoofed local landline pattern

text: Scammer shares a screen or sends an image of a fabricated arrest warrant, FIR copy, or Supreme Court notice, often with real logos copied from government websites, to add visual legitimacy.
example_phrases: I am sending you the digital arrest warrant right now
please see the Supreme Court order attached
this is your FIR copy number

text: Victim is asked to disclose full bank balances, fixed deposits, and investment details 'for verification', which the scammer then uses to determine how much can be extracted.
example_phrases: tell me your complete bank balance across all accounts
how much money do you have in fixed deposits
we need to verify all your account details to clear your name

text: Caller claims to be from TRAI or the Department of Telecommunications, saying the victim's mobile number or SIM is linked to illegal activity, harassment complaints, or money laundering, and will be disconnected unless the victim cooperates. Common opener that hands off to a fake police officer.
example_phrases: your mobile number is being used for illegal activities and will be blocked
this is the Department of Telecommunications, your SIM will be deactivated in two hours
a complaint has been registered against your number for sending obscene messages

text: Caller impersonating cyber police tells the victim that their bank account has been identified as receiving proceeds of crime, that multiple victims have named them, and that the account will be frozen unless they prove the funds are clean.
example_phrases: your bank account is involved in a fraud complaint filed by multiple victims
your account received money stolen from a cyber crime victim
several people have named your account as the one that received the stolen funds

text: Caller claims the victim's Aadhaar number has been used to open fraudulent accounts, book parcels of contraband, or register criminal SIMs, establishing false personal culpability to justify the investigation.
example_phrases: your Aadhaar card has been misused in a criminal case
an account opened with your Aadhaar is under money laundering investigation
your Aadhaar was used to book a parcel containing illegal items

text: Automated or live call claiming a court has issued a summons or arrest warrant against the victim for a financial or criminal case, instructing them to press a key or stay on the line to speak to a case officer.
example_phrases: a summons has been issued against you, press one to speak to the case officer
an arrest warrant is active in your name for a financial fraud case
the honourable court has issued a non-bailable warrant against you

text: Victim is instructed that they are under 'digital arrest' and must remain physically inside a room, on camera, and may not leave, sleep, or attend to others until the fake investigation concludes -- sometimes lasting days.
example_phrases: you are under digital arrest and cannot leave your house
stay in front of the camera, you are not allowed to move until we finish
you cannot go to sleep until the interrogation is complete

text: Victim is explicitly forbidden from contacting family members, colleagues, or a lawyer during the call, and told that doing so is obstruction of justice or will worsen their charges. Isolates the victim from anyone who might recognise the scam.
example_phrases: do not contact your family or lawyer during this investigation
informing anyone will be treated as obstruction of justice
keep this strictly confidential or your charges will become non-bailable

text: Money demanded is framed as a temporary, fully refundable security deposit or good-faith amount that will be returned after verification, lowering the victim's resistance to transferring large sums.
example_phrases: deposit this amount as a refundable security, it will be returned after verification
this is a good faith amount, you will get it back once cleared
the money is completely safe and refundable within 24 hours

text: Victim is told to move funds to an account described as belonging to the RBI, a government treasury, or a court, lending false institutional legitimacy to what is actually a mule account controlled by the scammers.
example_phrases: transfer the money to this RBI monitored account for verification
move your funds to the government treasury account we provide
the court's verification account will hold your money safely

text: Scammer claims the victim's own accounts are compromised or about to be frozen, and that the only way to protect their savings is to move everything to a 'safe' account they control.
example_phrases: your accounts are compromised, move your money to a safe account immediately
to protect your savings from being frozen, transfer everything now
your bank has been hacked, we will keep your money safe during the investigation

text: Caller invokes the Narcotics Control Bureau or NDPS Act, claiming the victim is implicated in a drug trafficking case, to raise the perceived severity and fear of a long non-bailable sentence.
example_phrases: this is a serious offence under the NDPS Act
the Narcotics Control Bureau has opened a case against you
the parcel contained narcotic substances linked to your identity

text: Victim is pushed onto a video call (often Skype or WhatsApp) with a person in a police-style uniform and fake station backdrop, to simulate a real interrogation. Legitimate Indian agencies do not interrogate citizens over video call.
example_phrases: join this Skype call for the official interrogation
stay on video call so the officer can monitor you
keep your camera on for the duration of the digital arrest

text: Scammer claims the victim is being continuously watched or recorded and that their location, devices, or accounts are under live monitoring, deterring them from seeking help or hanging up.
example_phrases: you are under surveillance, we can see everything you do
our officer is monitoring you on camera at all times
any attempt to alert others will be recorded as evidence against you
